name: mcp
title: MCP
role: Transport that carries x402 and MPP payments in tool calls.
subset: tool discovery, invocation, payment-required and error mapping

spec.statement: Current: the current protocol version, which is ready for use and may continue to receive backwards compatible changes

exclusions.name: dns-rebinding-protection
exclusions.note: The adapter relies on the gateway's `onRequest` hook to validate Host and Origin for the MCP mount.

exclusions.name: MPP payment-required as JSON-RPC error -32042
exclusions.note: mppx reads challenges from the tool result's `_meta`.

exclusions.name: MPP verification failure as JSON-RPC error -32043
exclusions.note: mppx reads refusals from the tool result's `_meta`.

conformance.suite: Specification tests through the v1 and v2 SDK clients.
